question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>)</mo></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>)</mo></math> be the points on the line <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>50</mn></math>. Let the point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> divide the line segment <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></math> internally in the ratio <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mn>3</mn></math>. Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>25</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> be a directrix of the ellipse <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>E</mi><mo>:</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and the corresponding focus be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>S</mi></math>. If from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>S</mi></math>, the perpendicular on the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo></math>axis passes through <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math>, then the length of the latus rectum of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>E</mi></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Given: A(α,0) and B(0,β) lies on the line 5x+7y=50.

⇒5α+70=50, 50+7β=50

⇒α=10, β=507

Also, P divide the line segment AB internally in the ratio 7: 3.

⇒P≡7×0+3×107+3,7×507+3×07+3

⇒P≡3,5

⇒ae=3 as perpendicular from S passes through P

Now, 3x-25=0 is a directrix of the ellipse E:x2a2+y2b2=1

⇒x=253

We know that, directrix of an ellipse is given by x=±ae

⇒ae=253

Also, ae=3

⇒a=5, b=4

Length of LR =2b2a=325
